Add it to your phone

Android · Chrome or Samsung Internet

  1. Open this page in Chrome or Samsung Internet. From ChatGPT, use the menu to open the link in your browser.
  2. Tap Install on my phone above. If no prompt appears, open the browser menu and choose Install app, Install and create shortcut → Install, or Add to Home screen.
  3. Confirm, then open Base Finder from your phone’s app icon.
iPhone or iPad · Safari

Open this page in Safari. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → Add. Enable Open as Web App if offered.
